additional_info.subject: Problem Description
additional_info.body: After an updtae from 4.0.11 to 5.0.23, the charger was in default , we went on site to restart the charger, but without success. we flashed the CFAST on site and try to restart the chaarger but without success. The PLC is in issue, after quick analysis with Francois Winckel and Benjamin, the PLC Bios is out, need to change the PLC or reflash it . Part unplugged from the charger to send to Benjamin in Germany.
